meta.designPrinciple: One decade, fully committed. Every material cue points at 1988, not at a vague nostalgia -- and it stays on the signature surfaces that earn it, not smeared across the whole system.
meta.removedElement: First draft put a beveled, chrome-textured border on every message bubble to sell the 'old tech' feel. It made a long thread look like a wall of buttons instead of a conversation. Cut the bevel from ordinary bubbles -- kept it only on the avatar frame and the send button, the two places skeuomorphism's texture cue is supposed to live per style-taxonomy.md.

reducedMotion.strategy: GIF avatar swaps to a static exported frame -- authored separately, since GIF has no native reduced-motion pause state (see motion-icon-tiers.md's opt-in warning)

iconography.styleDescriptor: 2px stroke, hard corners with one deliberate bevel highlight per icon
iconography.setReference: Custom -- generic sets don't carry the bevel cue; GIF/PNG sprite set recommended over a live icon font here

idle.reducedMotionFallback: static exported frame -- authored separately, not auto-generated from the GIF

elevationScale.note: One of exactly two bevel surfaces -- see meta.removedElement.

iconSet.name: SVG Repo (filtered to MIT/CC0)
iconSet.note: No mainstream open-source set carries an authentic period bevel cue -- expect to hand-finish 4-6 signature glyphs (avatar frame, send button) rather than sourcing the whole set.

animationLibrary.name: n/a -- GIF tier
animationLibrary.note: GIF assets carry their own per-file license; author or source individually and verify, per motion-icon-tiers.md.
